signature.name: VTask.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule
signature.type: (R : Type u_1) -> {M : Type u_2} -> [CommSemiring R] -> {σ : Type u_3} -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> (w : σ → M) -> (m : M) -> Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ R)

conventions.statement: The zero polynomial belongs to VTask.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w m for every w and m, since weighted homogeneity is vacuously satisfied when there are no nonzero monomials.
conventions.note: This is required for submodule closure under addition and is the standard convention for graded polynomial rings.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] {σ M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (w : σ → M) (m n : M), VTask.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w m * VTask.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w n ≤ VTask.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w (m + n)
